notes:
Summary:
- Account: Emberfield DevIndex (developer tools + large-scale code search). HQ in Denver, legal entity in US; heavy EU customer base so asking for EU residency option.
- Primary ask: high-throughput embeddings + reranking pipeline for code search across monorepos and artifact stores. Scale target: 15M-30M embedding vectors initially; incremental daily updates ~200k vectors/day; full reindex weekly (rolling).
- Performance targets:
  - P50 end-to-end (query + ANN + rerank): <120ms target, P95 <300ms hard requirement.
  - Cost target: <$0.005 per query (avg across traffic), willing to trade latency for cost up to a point.
  - Reranking: cross-encoder style re-ranker on top-50 candidates; expect GPU inference for reranker (low-latency, high-accuracy).
- Architecture preferences: prefer Dedicated for stable throughput; Private/VPC option for customer data residency and audit requirements. Needs Okta SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM for user sync, and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.
- Security/regulatory: SOC2 in scope; ISO27001 desirable; KMS-managed keys recommended. Retention policy: logs 7 years for compliance team.
- POC done 2025-02-03 (see ff_20250203_emberfield_poc_call). Setup: 4 x A10G equivalent on dedicated pool; local ANN store (HNSW) + Redis-based prefix cache; reranker on 1 GPU with batched cross-encoder.
- POC observations (engineering notes):
  * Embedding ingestion: bulk upload pipeline OK; incremental ingest latency ~2-3 minutes per batch (2000 docs). Need faster near-real-time for CI-triggered pushes.
  * ANN candidate recall stable at 96% for top-100 with current index params; cost for smaller ef/search to meet <120ms requires more aggressive quantization.
  * Reranker latency: 1-Batch (size=32) cross-encoder for top-50 avg 85ms on A10G; p95 spikes to 220ms when under concurrent load.
  * KV/prefix caching reduced token-level compute for doc snippets significantly; cache hit rate currently 62% on POC traffic pattern.
  * Reindexing: weekly full reindex causes CPU/GPU contention; request: suggestion for cold reindexing strategy and throttled background indexing via Redwood Optimize.
- Business/Procurement notes:
  * Interested in 12-month reserved Dedicated capacity if latency and predictable cost prove out.
  * Wants explicit quantization / model recommendations from Redwood Optimize for code-embeddings model variants.
  * Legal: DPA needs EU data residency annex; export controls review pending.
- Quotes / customer voice:
  * CTO (A. Moreno): "We cannot accept POOR tail latency — any >300ms tails kill adoption for our internally-facing developer tools."
  * Head of infra (S. Lin): "Reindex cadence is non-negotiable; deploys trigger reindexes and must not affect live queries."
- Timeline / recent activity (bulleted):
  * 2025-01-15: Lead created from inbound case study signup.
  * 2025-01-22: Initial discovery call (Avery Collins) — captured requirements and asked for POC.
  * 2025-01-28: Security questionnaire submitted by Emberfield, items on SAML and KMS flagged.
  * 2025-02-03: 30-day POC kick-off (ff_20250203_emberfield_poc_call).
  * 2025-02-07: Mid-POC sync – observed reranker p95 spikes; SE recommended batched reranks + pre-filtering.
  * 2025-02-08: Pricing model review with procurement; asked for committed vs burst pricing comparison.
  * 2025-02-10: Redwood delivered Optimize suggestions (batch sizes, quant levels, recommended model family).
- POC success criteria (customer-defined):
  1) Sustained tail latency P95 <300ms for production traffic profile.
  2) Query cost <= $0.005 avg.
  3) Reindex strategy that does not impact live traffic (throttled background pipelines + cold index swap).
  4) Compliance: SAML SSO + audit log streaming + DPA signed.
- Next steps (short):
  1) SE to run stress test with 2x concurrent query volume and capture p50/p95 (Ravi scheduled 2025-02-12).
  2) Legal to provide updated DPA with EU residency clause (owner: Emberfield legal).
  3) Pricing: finalize reserved capacity tier vs. burst capacity add-on; AE to send formal quote by 2025-02-14.
  4) Tech: iterate on reranker batching strategy and test sharding of reranker service.
- Open items / blockers (short):
  * DPA + EU residency annex pending.
  * Okta metadata format mismatch — requires small change to their IdP config.
  * Need clearer cost estimate for frequent weekly full reindex on 30M vectors.
